name: CSN 9302 异物击中,疑似冰雹,仪表失真

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 302, you are at parking bay 235, you are ready for push back, contact Guangzhou Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 302，在 235 号停机位，准备好推出，联系广州地面。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, bay 235, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN9302，235 号机位，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, stand by, expect 20 minutes delay, thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，等待，预计延误 20 分钟，雷暴正接近机场，多架飞机因等待天气好转而等待。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 302, report tug is ready.
B: Tell the controller the tug is in position and you are ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 302，报告拖车准备好。
B：告诉管制员拖车已到位，你准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: The tug is ready and we are ready for push back, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 拖车已准备好，我们准备好推出，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, push back approved, facing east, runway 19, stand by for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，同意推出，机头朝东，跑道 19，等待开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, runway 19, stand by for start up, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝东，跑道 19，等待开车，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have been waiting for the start of clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已等待开车许可约 15 分钟，联系广州地面请求开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, we have been waiting for about 15 minutes, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN9302，我们已等待约 15 分钟，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，预计 49 离场，自行决定开车，QNH 1008，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 49 离场，自行决定开车，QNH 1008，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
C: China southern 302, taxi via Juliette, Delta, Tango 3 and Tango 4 to holding point runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，经 Juliette、Delta、Tango 3 和 Tango 4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to holding point runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J、D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, hold short of Tango 3, give way to Airbus 320 crossing from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，Tango 3 外等待，避让从右至左穿越的 Airbus 320。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of T3, give way to A320, CSN9302.

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via Delta, Tango 3 and Tango 4 to holding point runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，交通已脱离，继续经 Delta、Tango 3 和 Tango 4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to holding point runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding point Foxtrot 1, runway 19, you are fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 Foxtrot 1、跑道 19 等待点，完全准备好，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN9302, holding point F1, runway 19, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN9302，F1 等待点，跑道 19，完全准备好。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 302, line up and wait runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of runway 19.
B: Read back ATC clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 302，跑道 19 进跑道等待，注意跑道 19 离场端雷暴正在发展。
B：复诵 ATC 许可并因天气请求离地后右转。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 19, request right turn when airborne due weather, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 19 进跑道等待，因天气请求离地后右转，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, turn right heading 120, direct to Lima Mike November, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，右转航向 120，直飞 Lima Mike November，跑道 19 可以起飞，地面风 180 度，5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 120, direct to LMN, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，跑道 19 可以起飞，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120, contact Guangzhou Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120，联系广州进近。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN9302，已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，QNH 1008 爬升至 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008, CSN9302.

cards.audioText: B: During climb, suddenly you have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, your instruments are indicating incorrectly, report it to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你突然被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，向广州进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, we have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN9302，我们被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 302, roger, descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 302，收到，下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导至跑道 19 五边。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导至跑道 19 五边，CSN9302。

cards.audioText: C: China southern 302, contact Guangzhou Tower on 118.5.
C: China Southern 302, runway 19, cleared to land.
